Use case: ads-marketing. ONE finished premium Chinese visual-novel publicity poster, portrait 9:16, request native 1440x2560 or the best supported portrait size. Full artwork with professionally integrated Chinese typography, not a mockup, not a contact sheet. The user supplied the old v1.0 poster as visual REFERENCE, and wants an updated v1.1 poster in its visual language. Keep a strong family resemblance in composition, painterly realism, rich detail, large Song-style Chinese title and publicity typography. Current version is still in development. Replace ALL old v1.0 / 正式版发布 / 七条路线 / 十三种结局 text with the exact new copy below. Do not invent a release date, URL, QR, platform logo, watermark or extra credits. Simplified Chinese text must be exact and highly readable. Minimum 6% safe margin. No picture border or collage frames.
Primary request: 方案A“雨后群像”。Closely echo input 1's full-bleed purple-blue rainy twilight, glowing amber sunset horizon, modest ordinary Bijie Guizhou mid-rise apartments, rain-wet river, stone arch bridge, warm lamp reflections, and a beautifully integrated ensemble-movie montage. This is artistic publicity imagery, not a literal real-place reconstruction.
Reference roles: input 1 is COMPOSITION / PALETTE / TYPOGRAPHY reference only. Inputs 2,3,4 OVERRIDE all character identity/hair/clothing in the old poster and must govern the three featured adult men. Input 2 文文: recognizable 23-year-old adult broad round face and black eyebrows, GOLDEN BLOND SHORT BUZZ CUT, faded LIGHT BLUE DENIM JACKET open over IVORY crew-neck tee, turned sleeve cuffs; keep his face recognizable, not a generic idol, no black hair or dark repair jacket. Center foremost, largest, gently looking toward the light. Input 3 毛狼: slim adult wavy black short hair, black tee with the reference's multicolored abstract flower shapes, black wrist support, supporting left. Input 4 师匠: stockier adult, black rectangular glasses, black bucket hat with white scattered markings, white graphic T-shirt, supporting right. Match each reference face, natural proportion and texture. Three figures chest-to-waist, relaxed hands, no weird fingers.
Midground bridge: exactly FOUR very small anonymous adult female silhouettes, representing the four non-hidden heroines only, plus a tiny yellow sphere hint near the railing for the hidden character. No fifth female or secret-character human-form spoiler. No extra foreground people, no romance pose. Upper 30% dramatic cloudscape and giant ivory title. Center bridge and horizon. Three men in lower half above a clearly visible golden version block and footer. Rich painterly realistic illustration, warm rim light on denim, atmospheric rain, emotionally grounded.
Text (verbatim only):
top kicker “互动视觉小说”
very large title on two lines “毕节，” / “雨停之前”
small location “贵州 · 毕节”
large lower version block “v1.1 新版预告”
tagline “雨停之前，也往前走。”
bottom line “六条路线 · 十四种结局 · 双后日谈”
small bottom status “开发中”
Do not retain any old release claims.
